# Miracle Websoft - Shopify Development Agency

## Who We Are

Miracle Websoft is a dedicated Shopify development agency founded in 2015 and based in Chandigarh, India. We serve ecommerce brands, Shopify merchants, SMBs, agencies and startups in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia and Europe.

Miracle Websoft focuses on Shopify and Shopify Plus: store launches, speed and conversion fixes, migrations to Shopify, Plus checkout extensions, international expansion, custom Shopify apps and dedicated Shopify developers on monthly plans. Every offer has a fixed price, a timeline and a guarantee. The team also takes on WordPress, Moodle, CRM and custom software work, but Shopify is the core specialty.

Founder Karam Singh Mehra is a Top Rated Plus full stack and Shopify developer on Upwork with 10+ years of experience, a Shopify Certified & Verified Partner. Miracle Websoft has completed 700+ Shopify projects, earned $600K+ on Upwork and delivered 15,000+ hours for global clients.

## Core Services

- **Outcome-based Shopify offers** - fixed-scope offers, each with one promised result, a fixed price, a timeline and a guarantee: launch-ready store in 7 days (from $600), Speed Fix Sprint (no measurable improvement, no fee), conversion audit + fix, zero-loss migration, Shopify Plus checkout upgrade, international expansion, and a dedicated Shopify developer on a monthly plan (from $299/mo).
- **Shopify Services** - Shopify store development, Shopify Plus development, theme customization, custom features, app integration, migration, maintenance, API development and private apps.
- **CRO Services** - conversion rate optimization, user journey analysis, Microsoft Clarity review, heatmap analysis, checkout optimization, product page optimization, homepage optimization, landing page optimization and A/B testing.
- **Performance Services** - Shopify speed optimization, Core Web Vitals, PageSpeed improvements, performance audits, LCP, CLS and INP improvements.
- **AI Services** - AI business automation, AI workflow automation, OpenAI integrations, AI chatbots, AI customer support, AI internal tools, AI agents, AI website development, AI content automation and AI consulting.
- **Web Development** - business websites, ecommerce websites, custom web applications, CRM development, admin panels, client portals and API integrations.
- **Full Stack Development** - custom web applications with React.js, Node.js, Laravel, PHP and Yii2; dashboards, admin panels, business portals, SaaS applications, authentication and role-based permissions, MySQL and Firebase.
- **API Integration** - REST, GraphQL and webhook integrations; CRM, ERP, LMS and ecommerce integrations; payment, subscription and shipping integrations; data synchronization.
- **Custom Software (Stop Renting, Start Owning)** - custom alternatives to per-user licensed CRM, ERP, invoicing, inventory and SaaS tools; one-time development investment with no recurring per-user licence fees for your own software (hosting, maintenance and third-party services may still have costs).
- **CRM & LMS Development** - SuiteCRM customization, modules and performance optimization; Moodle LMS plugins, themes, RESTful web services, enrollment and WordPress-Moodle integration.
- **WordPress Plugin Development** - custom WordPress plugins and WooCommerce extensions.
- **Maintenance & Technical Support** - bug fixing, debugging, WordPress/WooCommerce and Shopify speed optimization, PHP, JavaScript, database and API troubleshooting.
- **White Label Development** - silent development partner for agencies and studios.
- **Referral Program** - commission program for referred Shopify and ecommerce projects.

United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia and Europe.
